test_title: PYST 09: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the correct active form. "The temple has been visited by thousands of pilgrims."

options.text: Thousands of pilgrims were visiting the temple.
Thousands of pilgrims have visited the temple.
Thousands of pilgrims are visiting the temple.
Thousands of pilgrims had visited the temple.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "The temple has been visited by thousands of pilgrims."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the original subject "thousands of pilgrims" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "has been visited" to "have visited" (present perfect active).
 
• Ensure the object "the temple" remains in its original position for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Thousands of pilgrims have visited the temple."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Thousands of pilgrims were visiting the temple." – Incorrect tense (past continuous).
 
• **Option 3: **"Thousands of pilgrims are visiting the temple." – Incorrect tense (present continuous).
 
• **Option 4: **"Thousands of pilgrims had visited the temple." – Incorrect tense (past perfect).
